extra_vocab.en: to give someone what they need or have enough space for them
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是「滿足、照顧（特殊需求）」的意思：餐廳願意為兩位對堅果過敏的客人準備合適的餐點。語氣禮貌正式，常見於服務業與客服用語。

forms.label: 名詞
forms.zh: 住宿；（空間或需求的）安排

example.en: We will try to accommodate your request for a later date.
example.zh: 我們會盡量配合您延後日期的要求。

example.en: The hotel can accommodate guests with special needs.
example.zh: 這間飯店能照顧有特殊需求的客人。

example.en: This room can accommodate a large group of up to fifty people.
example.zh: 這個房間最多可容納五十人的大團體。

example.en: We changed the meeting time to accommodate her schedule.
example.zh: 我們更改了會議時間以配合她的行程。

examples.en: Our restaurant can accommodate guests with food allergies.
examples.zh: 我們餐廳能照顧有食物過敏的客人。

examples.en: The conference room is too small to accommodate everyone.
examples.zh: 這間會議室太小，容納不下所有人。

examples.en: We apologize that we cannot accommodate your request this time.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，這次我們無法配合您的要求。

examples.en: The hotel accommodated our team even though it was fully booked.
examples.zh: 雖然客滿，飯店還是為我們的團隊安排了房間。

confusable.diff: accommodation 是名詞，常指「住宿」；accommodate 是動詞，指「容納、配合」。兩者都是雙 c、雙 m，拼字要小心。
adapt 是自己調整以適應環境；accommodate 是提供空間或配合別人的需求。

example.en: The company will pay for your hotel accommodation.
example.zh: 公司會支付你的飯店住宿費用。

example.en: The staff were very accommodating about our schedule change.
example.zh: 員工對我們更改行程非常願意配合。
